snippet.description:
Do DonaldTrump's voters still believe in him? Vox's Astead Herndon traveled to a town hall in Ohio for gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy and asked the Republicans gathered to rate the president’s second term.

Watch the full episode of America, Actually wherever you get your podcasts or here on YouTube this Saturday.
